hypothesis: NOAA LCDv2 supplies complete, identity-stable two-year hourly predictors and SOD maximum-temperature labels for all three prespecified protected probability-test stations.

window.timestamp_semantics: NOAA LCDv2 local standard time; no DST adjustment
window.decision_cutoff: 18:00 local standard time on target-minus-one day

invalid_temperature_followup: A raw V1 failure caused only by physically invalid temperature does not permit scoring. Apply the already-frozen deterministic null-temperature/dependent-RH correction in a separate immutable V2, requiring no more than 0.01% corrected rows per station, then rerun all gates.

decision_rule.all_gates_pass: Freeze protected data artifacts, but do not probability-score them before the development-only candidate is selected and frozen.
decision_rule.any_gate_fails: Do not probability-score; diagnose and use only the preregistered invalid-temperature correction when applicable.
